decision.explanation: The provided documents contain contradictory assertions regarding Tadao Takashima's spouse. Document 1 (D1S2, D1S15) explicitly states he was married to 'Hanayo Sumi', supported by quotes from colleagues and references to Ministry of Health records. Document 2 (D2S7, D2S21) explicitly states he was married to 'Evelyn Herbert Webb' in 1965, citing a specific ceremony and academic studies. Per the instruction to treat all audits and saved answers as fallible and to preserve distinct valid referents where competing assertions exist without resolving them as errors, both names are included as valid answers derived from the source text.
